home.audio_hint_text: Background music will start after your first click on this page (browser policy). Click anywhere to start.
home.hero_desc: Magguru connects teachers and students in one platform. Manage classes, students, materials, question banks, and educational games — all in one place.
home.feat_modes_desc: Competitive, cooperative, endless, and practice — each mode is designed for a different learning goal.
home.feat_reports_desc: Copy the daily report into ChatGPT or Meta AI and get ready-made analysis.
home.feat_practice_desc: Students practice freely, seeing the correct answer and its explanation instantly.
home.feat_bank_desc: Ready-to-use Excel template, with an AI assistant to generate questions faster.
home.feat_audio_desc: Each teacher can set their own music per page, with instant mute.
home.feat_themes_desc: 8 different colors to customize the dashboard — without affecting student pages.
home.cta_ready_desc: Create your first class, add students with PINs, and start your first game in 2 minutes.

login_teacher.desc_sign_in: Enter your email and password to access the dashboard.
login_teacher.desc_forgot: Enter your email, and we'll send you a reset link.
login_teacher.success_reset: Reset link has been sent to your email. Check your inbox or spam folder.
login_teacher.register_desc: Click the button below to contact the admin via WhatsApp.
login_teacher.register_note: A ready message will open — fill in your name, email, and (optionally) your desired password.
login_teacher.register_footer: Self-registration is disabled. All accounts are created by the admin.
login_teacher.wa_message:

login_student.hero_desc: Log in with your name and PIN, then choose the practice you want.

dashboard.welcome_desc: Manage classes, question banks, and educational games from one place.
dashboard.students_mgmt_desc: Add students to classes and create a PIN for each student.

classes.title: Classes
classes.subtitle: Create and manage classes. Each class has a unique code for students.
classes.create_desc: Fill in the class name and subject (optional).
classes.empty_desc: Create your first class to start managing students.
classes.delete_confirm: Delete this class? All data (students, materials, games) will be deleted too.

class_detail.students_empty: No students in this class yet
class_detail.games_empty: No games for this class yet

reports.header_desc: Summarize today's results, then copy the report to ChatGPT / Meta AI for deeper analysis.
reports.help_copy_md: Copy MD — if you want to save the report in a document (Notion / Obsidian / Word).
reports.help_copy_ai: Copy MD + AI Prompt — paste into ChatGPT / Meta AI, and it will automatically analyze student performance and give recommendations.
reports.cleanup_desc: Delete all records older than 7 days (also automatic every day).
reports.cleanup_confirm: Delete all records older than 7 days?

audio_settings.header_desc: You can add several music tracks and choose which pages play each track. Music will not play on materials, class, and question bank pages to keep focus.
audio_settings.err_no_file: You must choose an audio file.
audio_settings.help_item_2: YouTube Audio Library — from YouTube Studio.
audio_settings.help_item_3: Make sure the file is MP3 and under 5MB.
audio_settings.form_hint_keep_file: Leave empty to keep the current file.
audio_settings.form_hint_compress: 💡 Tip: large files may not work. Use an MP3 compression site to reduce size while keeping quality.
audio_settings.form_err_file_size_suffix: MB. Please compress the file first.
audio_settings.list_empty_desc: Use the form above to add your first music track.

admin.header_desc: Manage teacher accounts and active student sessions.
admin.teachers_desc: You can deactivate any account, or send a password reset link to the teacher.

admin.reset_success_suffix:

admin.sessions_desc: Each student appears once. Press End to log the student out from all their devices.
admin.sessions_empty_desc: When students log in, they will appear here.
admin.sessions_end_confirm_suffix: ? They will need to log in again on all devices.

account.header_desc: Change your name, and quickly access history and reports pages.
account.change_pw_desc: To change your password, use the "Forgot Password" button on the login page — you'll receive an email with a secure link.
account.quick_links_desc: Quick access to history and reports pages.
account.link_students_desc: Performance details per student by mode
account.link_reports_desc: Summarize today and copy to ChatGPT / Meta AI

student.card_practice_desc: Practice freely with questions from your teacher — no time.
student.card_essay_desc: Write your answer and get instant AI scoring.
student.card_guided_desc: Join the teacher's room — requires a code.
student.practice_header_desc: Practice your teacher's questions freely. No time limit, and you can review every question and its answer anytime.
student.practice_empty_desc: Waiting for your teacher to add practices (endless or practice).
student.practice_help_1: Choose a practice from the list above.
student.practice_help_2: Questions appear one by one — no time limit.
student.practice_help_3: After each answer, you'll know if it's correct/wrong, and can view the explanation.
student.practice_help_4: Your progress is saved — come back anytime to review your answers or start over.
student.player_feedback_wrong_prefix: ✗ Wrong answer — the correct one is
student.player_no_explanation: No explanation available for this question.
student.player_choose_hint: Choose an answer from the options above
student.player_submit_error: Failed to save answer. Try again.
student.player_confirm_reset: Delete all your answers and start over?
student.player_score_ok: Fair performance, review the questions again
student.player_score_low: You need to review the answers
student.essay_list_header_desc: Write your answer then submit it — it will be graded automatically by AI, and you'll receive detailed feedback.
student.essay_list_empty_desc: Waiting for your teacher to add a task.
student.essay_player_notice_1: The full question only appears after you press "Start Writing".
student.essay_player_notice_2: The countdown starts as soon as you begin writing.
student.essay_player_notice_3: It will be submitted automatically when time runs out.
student.essay_player_notice_4: You only have one submission — it cannot be edited after submitting.
student.essay_player_intro_question_hint: The full question will appear once you start writing.
student.essay_player_err_short: Answer is too short (at least 10 characters).
student.essay_player_err_timeout: Time is up — no answer was submitted.
student.essay_player_err_submit: Failed to submit answer. Try again.
student.essay_player_err_grading: Submitted, but automatic grading failed. The teacher will grade it manually.
student.essay_player_grading_desc: Your answer is being graded. This may take 5-15 seconds.
student.material_no_content: No text content in this material yet.

join.title: Enter Game Room
join.desc_prefilled: Enter your name to join the room.
join.desc_normal: Enter the room code and your name to join.
join.room_session_closed_desc: The teacher started a new session in the same room. You can rejoin.
join.room_podium_congrats: 🎉 Congrats! You made it to the podium
join.room_locked_desc: You cannot join this room right now.
join.room_waiting_desc: Waiting for the teacher to start the game.
join.room_countdown_hint: The question will appear after the countdown
join.room_answer_recorded: Your answer has been recorded. Waiting for other participants...
join.review_no_explanation: No explanation available for this question.
